accepted_review_findings:
[reviewer finding R3, minor] The F-BG-05 evidence record cites 'Section 4 closing paragraph (mitigating boundary effects as future work)'. The closing paragraph of Section 4 (S4.p5) reports empirical equivariance errors that grow at the truncation boundary. It does not call mitigation future work; that statement is only in S6.p1. The copied locator therefore attributes content to a paragraph that does not contain it. The public F-BG-05 statement and BR-04 content are themselves accurate: S3.p8 and the abstract support the truncation, local-correctness, boundary-effect and interleaving points, and S6.p1 supports BR-04's future-work bullet. The defect is limited to the private provenance record, which judges may consult.
Required repair: In output/package.json (and package.constructor_original.json), change facts[F-BG-05].evidence[1].locator to: 'Section 3, paragraph S3.p8 (truncation and boundary effects); Section 6 paragraph S6.p1 (mitigating boundary effects as important future work)'. Optionally add 'Section 4 paragraph S4.p5 (equivariance errors blow up at the truncation boundary)' if the empirical boundary statement is meant to be cited. Change nothing else; no public asset hash changes.
